name: Deal Room
note: One activity log drives everything: the SVG org map's coverage curves (weight = touches, dashed when a relationship has gone cold), each stakeholder's last-touch label, the drawer history and the weekly in/out chart. The mutual action plan lays every row on its parent's columns with grid subgrid, and ticking off a late critical-path step pulls the projected close back while MEDDPICC radios and stances re-score the deal on an @property ring. name: Territory Planner
note: Paint hex districts between six field reps with the pointer or the keyboard: territory borders are rebuilt from shared hex edges, every book re-weighs against a ±10% band, and a registered @property drives the balance dial. Auto-balance runs a greedy boundary-swap solver that never splits a territory, one animated move at a time, and the whole run undoes in one step; set --dbc-territory-h to 100dvh in an app.

note: Every account is scored from six raw signals by a weighted model; drag a weight and blocks re-tier and restack in the month they renew on transform-only springs, while expected GRR (a registered @property drives its bullet) and at-risk ARR recompute. Save plays in the account drawer preview their change in expected ARR before you commit, including the trade-off of rightsizing seats; set --dbc-renewal-h to 100dvh in an app.
